probe_finding: Definition (author @throwthedamball, deep-scroll catalog, read 2026-10-15): the author's work is organized as FIFTEEN situational split families, each splitting standard production by a game-state or scheme condition: (1) coverage (man/zone — homed at C-283), (2) blitz, (3) pressure, (4) play-action, (5) box count, (6) stunts, (7) 1-on-1 (by position), (8) double teams (by position), (9) island rate (offensive tackles left 1-on-1), (10) press coverage, (11) depth/field-area (deep / short / intermediate / middle / screen), (12) pocket movement / scramble, (13) down-distance/situation (incl. obvious-passing, 3rd-and-long), (14) first-read, (15) run scheme (inside zone / outside zone / PROE). Role in-engine: this catalog is the taxonomy the situational layer reasons in — a premise that says 'this QB, against THIS condition' needs the condition to exist as a named split, and this record is where the full named set lives. The family's individually-homed members (C-283, C-309-C-316) carry their own definitions and stamped instances.
